title: Infinitely many primes with a fixed Frobenius field for an elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$
summary: In 1987, Elkies proved the striking result that every elliptic curve over $\mathbb{Q}$ has infinitely many supersingular primes. Motivated by this theorem and its connection with the Lang-Trotter conjecture, we study the analogous problem for Frobenius fields of elliptic curves. For certain families of non-CM elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{Q}$ and imaginary quadratic fields $K$, we prove that there exist infinitely many primes $p$ for which the Frobenius field of $E$ at $p$ equals $K$.
